openAsApp: Open Murmur as an app (npm run tauri dev) to record.
englishModelMissing: To record in English, download the English model.
deleteMessageWithAudio: The transcript, notes and saved audio of “{{title}}” will be deleted. This can't be undone.
deleteMessage: The transcript and notes of “{{title}}” will be deleted. This can't be undone.
coverNeedsModel: Turn on the summary in Settings › Intelligence and download the model.
coverNeedsKey: Connect the account in Settings › Intelligence to generate the summary.
coverAfterRecording: It can be generated once the recording ends.
missingModelBody: Murmur transcribes with a model that runs on this Mac. You only need to download it once.
emptyBody: Record a meeting and the transcript will appear live, split by speaker. Everything is processed on this Mac: local means private.
consentReminder: Remember to ask participants for their consent.
exportScreensTitle: Choose where to save the screenshots
retranscribeLabel: Whisper listens to the audio again in:
retranscribeMessage: Whisper will listen to the recording again and write every line in {{language}}. Who spoke and when stays the same, and so do lines you corrected by hand. It will take about {{minutes}} min, and then the summary is made again if you have it on.
retranscribeNeedsWhisper: Transcribing again needs the Whisper model.
markdownSaved_other: Saved as Markdown, in two files
importWhileRecording: Stop recording before opening a file.
dropTitle: Drop the file to transcribe it
dropFormats: Audio (mp3, m4a, wav, ogg…) or video (mp4, mov, mkv, webm). Murmur works out the language on its own.
dropLater: It will start once the current recording or transcription is done.
importLanguage: Language: {{language}}. If that's wrong, you can transcribe it again in another one when it's done.
importLanguageUnclear: Couldn't tell the language. Transcribing in your usual one: {{language}}.
glossaryOffer: Add {{words}} to the glossary? The transcription will spell it right next time.
continueBlockedFinishing: This meeting is still being finished
calendarSyncEmpty: macOS hasn't loaded any calendars yet. Check again in a while.
translateLabel: The summaries' model translates it, leaving the original as it is:
translateNeedsModel: Needs a language model: Gemma downloaded, or Claude or ChatGPT connected in Settings › Intelligence.
whisperCaOffer: There's a new Whisper for Catalan
whisperCaOfferText: The Barcelona Supercomputing Center's: in our tests, better than the current one for Central, Valencian and Balearic Catalan. It takes {{size}}.
whisperOffer: Let Whisper go over your meetings
whisperOfferText: When a meeting ends, Whisper listens to it again and rewrites the text, with punctuation and capitals. All on this computer. It takes {{size}}.
introHint: If there's more than one of you in the room, each can say “Murmur, I'm…” and Murmur will add the name.
obsidianChooseVault: Choose your Obsidian vault in Settings › Export.
micLostDetail: Murmur is opening it again. If it doesn't come back, check that it's connected or choose another in Settings › Audio.

after.title: What should I do now?

what.speakers: Listens to the voices again and fixes who said each sentence.
what.text: Rewrites the text, more accurately, with Whisper.
what.punctuation: Adds full stops, commas and capitals.
what.cover: Title, summary, decisions and tasks, with {{engine}}.

speakers.model: There isn't enough audio to check it.
speakers.audio: It needs the meeting's audio, which wasn't saved.

text.mixed: Not yet with Catalan and Spanish mixed: it would turn one language into the other.
text.model: Download Whisper in Settings › Transcription first.
text.audio: It needs the meeting's audio, which wasn't saved.

punctuation.model: Catalan only, and its model needs downloading in Settings › Transcription.

cover.engine: It needs the local model or a key, in Settings › Intelligence.

after.noAudio: The audio isn't saved: whatever you don't do now with Whisper and the speakers can't be done later.
after.rememberRecording: It'll remember this for the next recording.
after.rememberFile: It'll remember this for the next file.
